Gate 4's duplicate-path fixture overwrites one regular file through the same inode,
so its 20 full observations prove truncation and do not satisfy mandatory namespace
replacement coverage. This audit traces the complete qualification decision path,
tests real filesystem replacement evidence through constructed transport frames,
and preserves the exact historical NOT_QUALIFIED decision.

The audit also reproduces two independent validation defects: both readers silently
coerce Boolean/float stat fields into integers, and the adapter accepts differing
start/completion association kinds. Eighteen added production lines reject those
malformed records. Generic model/oracle/feedback, the producer, fixtures, target
options and acceptance thresholds remain unchanged.

Task Contract: the user's “InodeFence — Engine and Qualification Audit”, Phases A–D.
Baseline: `0eb527f88aa8a4015544d2f6b0eabfebe079bf18` from draft #89; historical
execution: `36ff7fdb0e31db72b3e581fd1c089b712b4a7b4e`.

Audit scope: two converters/readers, focused engine and qualification controls,
analysis report, and an unapplied Task Contract proposal for native replacement
coverage. The proposal requires Runtime ground truth and review before any fixture
map or multi-operation semantics can change.

Validation:

- Existing related tests: 42 passed at baseline.
- New regression tests before the fix: 33 failed / 11 passed; after: 89 related tests passed.
- Supported non-root Dev Container baseline `make check`: 1,387 passed with all canonical checks.
- Supported non-root Dev Container final `make check`: 1,434 passed; Ruff, format,
  Pyright, environment and docs passed. `git diff --check` passed.
- Fresh read-only readers before/after the patch each verified 320 native bundles
  and 160 stock records and reproduced the exact historical summary. The supported
  non-root reader independently confirmed it again.
- All 1,180 historical file checksums and the session archive hash remain unchanged.
- Controlled filesystem positive frames use synthetic association/transport and are
  engineering tests; they do not qualify native observation.

Historical result remains 480/480 completed, 13/14 criteria passing,
`V2_NATIVE_EFFECT_OBSERVATION_NOT_QUALIFIED`; duplicate-path truncation 20/20,
replacement 0/20. Gate 5 and native campaigns remain BLOCKED / NOT_RUN.
No full Gate 4 rerun or merge was performed.

This draft targets main per repository workflow and therefore includes the existing
unmerged prerequisites from #89 / the v2 stack. Review the audit delta against
`0eb527f`; the original branch, PR #89, main and Runtime work are unchanged.
It requires prerequisite review/integration and is not ready to merge.

## Purpose

Preserve the evidence-grounded resolution of the native v2 replacement-coverage blocker without weakening or reclassifying the failed v2 gate.

## Status

BLOCKED_FOR_REVIEW / PROPOSED / NOT_IMPLEMENTED / NOT_QUALIFIED.

Merging this documentation does not approve v3, authorize implementation, qualify observation, or permit a native campaign.

## Evidence basis

- duplicate regular-path fixture reused one inode and truncated it in 20/20 qualification runs
- exercised real node-tar rebinding used unlink followed by create, mkdir, link, or symlink operations
- 18/18 independently verified diagnostic bundles contained zero v2 namespace_replacement events
- inode-number reuse means separated equal dev/inode observations do not establish continuous identity
- the existing v2 decision remains V2_NATIVE_EFFECT_OBSERVATION_NOT_QUALIFIED

## Proposal

Define a future separately versioned namespace_rebinding_sequence composite only if human scientific review approves it. The composite would retain both underlying v2 effects, require explicit absence checkpoints and a producer-supported dependency edge, reject truncation and fictional event ordering, and use new schemas/policy IDs.

## Prohibited by this PR

- changing FilesystemEffectEvent v2 or its replacement criterion
- modifying producer, reader, fixtures, feedback semantics, C0-C4, or raw evidence
- treating multi-operation rebinding as v2 replacement
- rerunning the 480-run matrix
- issuing any qualification token
- running P0/P1/P2 effectiveness campaigns

## Validation

Canonical Dev Container make check: Ruff PASS; format PASS; Pyright 0 errors; 1,504 tests PASS; environment PASS; docs PASS.
